findings.observation: Increment is internally consistent and rule-compliant: units and sources present (CA-DATA-001), metadata/results/prose agree on values, method, threshold, code_version c011beef and empty exclusions (CA-DATA-002), convergence declared and met (1.31e-07 < 1e-06 hartree, CA-METH-002), metadata self-describing (CA-REPRO-001). However, the reported binding energy of -6.16 kcal/mol at 2.96 angstrom is physically implausible for the declared methane--water complex: CP-corrected literature values are roughly -0.5 to -1 kcal/mol near ~3.5 angstrom C...O separation, and the reported value/distance pair is characteristic of a stronger hydrogen-bonded dimer such as the water dimer, suggesting a possible system or geometry mislabel. External physical plausibility is not covered by any numbered BLOCKER rule, so per CA-META-003 this judgement call is recorded as ADVISORY only.
